video_title: Hitting a Baseball or Making a 3? Aaron Judge Debates Hardest Things & Little Details of Being a PRO

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge compares baseball and basketball game start times
quotes.excerpt: You guys got no rain delays. You guys start on time.

text_blocks.speaker: Aaron Judge
text_blocks.text: That's the one thing that's crazy with baseball compared to basketball. You guys got no rain delays. You guys start on time.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: No, we don't start on time.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: If the game is at 7:30, we are starting at 7:43.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the mental toll of game delays
quotes.excerpt: My mentally checked out. That second half when I go, it's over.
quotes.quote: I am happy we don't have rain delays. If we had a rain delay, or any type of delay, it is over. My mentally checked out. That second half when I go, it's over.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the difficulty of hitting a baseball
quotes.excerpt: You got Paul Skenes throwing me 101 mile an hour sinker, splinker, and I'm trying to hit it.
quotes.quote: Hitting a baseball is by far the hardest thing to do in sports. You got Paul Skenes throwing me 101 mile an hour sinker, splinker, and I'm trying to hit it with this round bat. There is no way. That is too tough.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on Josh Hart's failed baseball career
quotes.excerpt: Josh gets in arguments with his wife Shannon a lot because he swears he could have gone D1.
quotes.quote: Josh gets in arguments with his wife Shannon a lot because he swears he could have gone D1 for baseball, and she says hell no. So, we might have to test it out.
